text: Carpentry is the craft of constructing and finishing wooden structures. It begins with planning the layout and construction of a building, followed by cutting and shaping the wood into the desired form. The first step in the process is varnish, an essential finish that provides protection and beauty to the wood. Once the structure is complete, joints are carefully assembled to ensure stability and proper alignment. Proper attention is paid to the craftsmanship of the joints to prevent leaks, cracks, or other issues. As the project nears completion, varnish is again applied to seal and protect the wood, ensuring it remains durable and attractive for years to come.
